package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type LearningPathGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
}

type LearningPathCollection interface {
	List(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPathList, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
	GetContext(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error)
	Activate(context.Context, string, string, int64, bool) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
	Pause(context.Context, string, string, int64) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
	Resume(context.Context, string, string, int64) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error)
}

type DiagnosticSnapshotGetter interface {
	GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error)
}

type LearningSessionService interface {
	Start(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	End(context.Context, string, string, int64) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	ListRecent(context.Context, string, int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
}

type StudentLearningJourneyHandler struct {
	AssignedLessons AssignedLessonContextGetter
	NextAction      NextActionGetter
	Completion      LessonCompletionService
	Paths           LearningPathGetter
	PathCollection  LearningPathCollection
	Diagnostics     DiagnosticSnapshotGetter
	Sessions        LearningSessionService
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Paths == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Paths.Handle(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, legacyLearningPathResponse(result))
}

// legacyStudentLearningPathResponse intentionally freezes the pre-multi-path
// representation used by GET /student/learning-path. New lifecycle fields are
// available only from the plural endpoints.
type legacyStudentLearningPathResponse struct {
	ID                   string                    `json:"id"`
	StudentID            string                    `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID             string                    `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string                    `json:"goal_code"`
	CurriculumRevision   string                    `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	CourseFingerprint    string                    `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PolicyVersion        string                    `json:"policy_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string                    `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string                    `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string                    `json:"reason_summary"`
	Version              int64                     `json:"version"`
	Items                []domain.LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	CreatedAt            time.Time                 `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt            time.Time                 `json:"updated_at"`
}

func legacyLearningPathResponse(path domain.StudentLearningPath) legacyStudentLearningPathResponse {
	return legacyStudentLearningPathResponse{
		ID: path.ID, StudentID: path.StudentID, CourseID: path.CourseID, GoalCode: path.GoalCode,
		CurriculumRevision: path.CurriculumRevision, CourseFingerprint: path.CourseFingerprint,
		PolicyVersion: path.PolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: path.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode: path.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: path.ReasonSummary, Version: path.Version,
		Items: path.Items, CreatedAt: path.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: path.UpdatedAt,
	}
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) ListLearningPaths(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.PathCollection == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning paths unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.PathCollection.List(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLearningPathByID(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.PathCollection == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning paths unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.PathCollection.Get(r.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result.Path)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLearningContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.PathCollection == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning context unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.PathCollection.GetContext(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) ActivateLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		ExpectedVersion int64 `json:"expected_version"`
		MakePrimary     bool  `json:"make_primary"`
	}
	handler.mutateLearningPath(w, r, &payload, func(
		ctx context.Context, collection LearningPathCollection, studentID, pathID string,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
		return collection.Activate(ctx, studentID, pathID, payload.ExpectedVersion, payload.MakePrimary)
	})
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) PauseLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		ExpectedVersion int64 `json:"expected_version"`
	}
	handler.mutateLearningPath(w, r, &payload, func(
		ctx context.Context, collection LearningPathCollection, studentID, pathID string,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
		return collection.Pause(ctx, studentID, pathID, payload.ExpectedVersion)
	})
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) ResumeLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		ExpectedVersion int64 `json:"expected_version"`
	}
	handler.mutateLearningPath(w, r, &payload, func(
		ctx context.Context, collection LearningPathCollection, studentID, pathID string,
	) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
		return collection.Resume(ctx, studentID, pathID, payload.ExpectedVersion)
	})
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) mutateLearningPath(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
	payload any,
	mutation func(context.Context, LearningPathCollection, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error),
) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.PathCollection == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning paths unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	if err := decodeJourneyJSON(w, r, payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := mutation(r.Context(), handler.PathCollection, studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"))
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLatestDiagnostic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Diagnostics == nil {
		http.Error(w, "diagnostics unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Diagnostics.GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) StartLearningSession(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Sessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		Goal               string `json:"goal"`
		CourseID           string `json:"course_id"`
		LessonID           string `json:"lesson_id"`
		TaskID             string `json:"task_id"`
		AnalyticsSessionID string `json:"analytics_session_id"`
	}
	if err := decodeJourneyJSON(w, r, &payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Sessions.Start(r.Context(), studentID, payload.Goal, payload.CourseID, payload.LessonID, payload.TaskID, payload.AnalyticsSessionID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) EndLearningSession(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Sessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		ExpectedVersion int64 `json:"expected_version"`
	}
	if err := decodeJourneyJSON(w, r, &payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Sessions.End(r.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "sessionID"), payload.ExpectedVersion)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLearningSession(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Sessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Sessions.Get(r.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "sessionID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentLearningJourneyHandler) ListLearningSessions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || handler.Sessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	limit := 5
	if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); raw != "" {
		value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "invalid limit", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		limit = value
	}
	result, err := handler.Sessions.ListRecent(r.Context(), studentID, limit)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": result})
}

func decodeJourneyJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 256<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("invalid trailing request data")
	}
	return nil
}
